purpose: Convert corrected atlas mapper scenes into persistent sheet-mapping knowledge so subsequent drafts focus on unmapped or weakly mapped source cells instead of re-sampling the same sheet area.
standaloneAuthority: Havenwild internal PCC remains the build/gate authority; Ember ingests this contract later from the GitHub-mirrored Havenwild repository.
workflow: Build Scene Draft from the selected sheet or loaded project.
User corrects scene layout and assigns semantic roles to selected pieces.
Learn From Scene writes learned_mapping records for exact source cells.
Generate Next Missing Draft skips learned/persisted cells and focuses unmapped coverage.
Export Handoff upgrades cells to validated_mapping evidence, but runtime publication still requires collision, sockets, topology and provider validation.

greenCheckSemantics.tileDraftCheck: A source cell appears in current unsaved pieces or draft_mapped records.
greenCheckSemantics.tileLearnedCheck: A source cell appears in learned_mapping records written from a corrected scene.
greenCheckSemantics.tileValidatedCheck: A source cell appears in validated_mapping records linked to an exported handoff.
greenCheckSemantics.sheetCheck: The sheet has mapped-sheet metadata and non-zero mapped coverage.
greenCheckSemantics.runtimeStar: Reserved for future cooked terrain/provider publication.

nonGoals: No runtime promotion from visual guessing.
No mutation of source PNG sheets.
No branch cutover to Ember until standalone Havenwild remains GREEN and committed.
